{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts lag behind price turning points, underestimating peaks by 0.5-1.0 and overestimating troughs",
    "Sentiment strength directly correlates with forecast accuracy - high confidence forecasts within volatile ranges perform better",
    "Mean reversion bias in model causes undershoot of price extremes, especially at 30-day horizons",
    "When price has strong momentum, model mean-reverting tendency causes systematic undershoot",
    "Sentiment turning points align better with forecast accuracy than sustained sentiment levels",
    "Price volatility regions determine forecast error magnitude - higher volatility increases divergence from model",
    "Sentiment divergence from price history predicts forecast failures - anomalous sentiment values indicate model limitations"
] }
